timeline-hero-desc: From planning to results, every election requires reliable technology, trained teams, and transparent processes.
timeline-1-desc: The electoral authority launches a tender to contract technological solutions.
timeline-1-end: COMITIA presents a technical and economic proposal adapted to the context.
timeline-2-desc: Voters, polling centers, equipment, and protocols are defined.
timeline-2-end: COMITIA customizes the system and defines the required infrastructure.
timeline-3-desc: Operators and electoral authorities are trained.
timeline-3-end: COMITIA develops materials and provides training for trainers.
timeline-4-desc: Kits, materials, and systems are delivered on time.
timeline-4-end: COMITIA organizes shipments, tracking, and contingency plans.
timeline-5-end: COMITIA manages the vote-counting system and ensures traceability.
timeline-6-desc: Voting takes place with on-site technical support.
timeline-6-end: COMITIA oversees operations, uploads data, and publishes preliminary results.
notebox-title: Comprehensive, Real-Time Management for Polling Stations
notebox-desc: Notebox is a management system for polling stations that assists election officials throughout the process, improves user experience, and enables instant decision-making by electoral bodies.
notebox-benefits-lead: Notebox enhances the work experience of election officials.
notebox-benefit-2: Intuitive interface, minimal prior training required.
notebox-benefit-3: Real-time access to information from all polling points.
notebox-benefit-4: Improves the polling station counting process.
notebox-benefit-5: Adaptable to local regulations and workflows.
notebox-implementation-lead: Designed to optimize the work of election officials and ensure agile, orderly electoral processes.
notebox-li-1: Minimizes operational errors through automatic validations.
notebox-li-2: Strengthens traceability of every action taken.
notebox-li-3: Centralizes and safeguards operational data in an encrypted, secure way.
notebox-li-4: Configured according to the regulations and procedures of each country or region.
notebox-li-5: Can integrate with other management and counting systems.
notebox-li-10: Any process requiring biometric identification with a mobile device.
notebox-li-11: Applicable in both public and private sectors.
bue-title: Secure, Transparent, and Auditable Voting for All.
bue-desc: Electronic ballot system that allows voters to select their choice on a touchscreen, print their ballot, and record the information on an RFID chip, ensuring accuracy, secrecy, and auditability.
bue-benefits-lead: BUE modernizes the voting process without replacing what already works, adding transparency, accessibility, and efficiency.
bue-benefit-1: Intuitive touchscreen interface to select candidates.
bue-benefit-2: Ballot printing and RFID chip registration.
bue-benefit-3: Enables visual verification of the ballot before casting it.
bue-benefit-4: Eliminates null or incorrectly completed ballots.
bue-benefit-5: Facilitates a public and controlled vote count.
bue-implementation-lead: BUE combines technology with the robustness of traditional procedures, enhancing the democratic experience.
bue-li-1: The vote is printed physically and recorded digitally.
bue-li-2: The machine stores no data: everything remains on the ballot.
bue-li-3: Information can be audited both electronically and manually.
bue-li-4: Used in multiple real electoral processes with high reliability standards.
bue-li-5: Recognized for strengthening transparency and efficiency in the electoral process.
bue-li-6: Universal and accessible design enables independent and secret voting for every citizen.
bue-li-7: Compatible with different regulatory frameworks and existing procedures.
turing-title: Fast, Secure, and Transparent Election Results.
turing-desc: Turing modernizes the transmission process by decentralizing data entry and ensuring that every result is validated, error-free, and delivered in real time.
turing-benefits-lead: Turing ensures accuracy, transparency, and speed in results transmission.
turing-benefit-1: Digital transmission of results and signed tally sheets.
turing-benefit-2: Error reduction through AI-powered interpretation and data entry.
turing-benefit-3: Direct verification of data entry by the polling authority.
turing-benefit-4: Reduced conflict in the final count thanks to standardized documentation.
turing-benefit-5: Enhanced security and transparency throughout the process.
turing-implementation-lead: Turing is designed to integrate into real electoral processes with efficiency and reliability.
turing-li-2: Quality control and double verification by the polling authority.
turing-li-3: On-site data digitization allowing party oversight of result transmission and consolidation stages.
turing-li-4: Successfully applied in municipal, provincial, and national elections.
turing-li-5: Applied in elections with multiple categories of offices.
turing-li-6: Compatible with different tally sheet formats and local requirements.
turing-li-7: Designed to integrate with existing systems without replacing them.
invote-title: Remote, Secure, and Verifiable Voting from Anywhere.
invote-desc: Invote is a fully verifiable end-to-end online voting system that allows citizens to cast their vote remotely, ensuring accessibility, integrity, and privacy throughout the process.
invote-benefits-lead: Invote expands democratic participation with the security and traceability required in an electoral process.
invote-benefit-1: Vote from anywhere with an internet connection.
invote-benefit-2: Integrity guaranteed: vote as intended, recorded as cast, and counted as recorded.
invote-benefit-3: Transparency and auditability throughout the process.
invote-benefit-4: Accessible for people with visual impairments or reduced mobility.
invote-benefit-5: Preserves ballot secrecy and prevents external interference.
invote-implementation-lead: Invote delivers an innovative voting experience — inclusive, secure, and internationally validated.
invote-li-1: Encryption and verification at every step of the process.
invote-li-3: Ballot auditable by both the voter and electoral authorities.
invote-li-10: Awarded at the Zero Project Conference, an initiative of the Essl Foundation promoting the rights of persons with disabilities, held at the United Nations in Vienna.
invote-li-11: Recognized for helping voters with visual, physical, and literacy-related disabilities to vote independently, preserving voter privacy and ballot confidentiality.
eos-title: Comprehensive centralization of electoral process information and contingency tracking system.
eos-desc: The Electoral Operations System is a comprehensive solution to plan, manage, and monitor every stage of an electoral process. It centralizes the entire operation in a secure, efficient, real-time digital environment.
eos-benefits-lead: A tool designed to ensure monitoring, efficiency, and traceability of electoral operations.
eos-benefit-1: Centralized management of schedules, resources, and teams.
eos-benefit-2: Real-time tracking of all phases of the process.
eos-benefit-3: Direct communication with field resources through customized apps.
eos-benefit-4: Visualization of key metrics and real-time alerts.
eos-benefit-5: Integration with other systems such as Notebox, Turing, and BUE.
eos-implementation-lead: Designed for electoral bodies that require maximum coordination in complex, large-scale scenarios.
eos-li-2: Full traceability of every recorded action.
eos-li-3: Secure storage and constant backup of critical data.
eos-li-4: Implemented in elections with multiple jurisdictions and polling centers.
eos-li-5: Ideal for national, municipal, or private processes of high complexity.
eos-li-6: Customizable according to the structure and regulations of each country.
eos-li-7: Scalable to adapt to both small and large-scale elections.
soe-desc: Through SOE in the United States, solutions are provided to state and county election bodies to help inform voters, train precinct officials, and publish results.
soe-li-1: A platform that enables the design of an election body’s website, maximizing voter information.
soe-li-2: Allows voters to view sample ballots, find their district and polling place, and more.
soe-li-4: A training platform for election officials.
soe-li-5: Provides training for precinct officials with videos and interactive content.
soe-li-7: Software that facilitates the design and publication of election results.
soe-li-8: Recognized for its ease of use, digital excellence, and accessibility.
